cases.description: 175 ids (about 6.1 KB of itemIds) is the most one request carries; the whole list goes and nothing is capped.
Jellyfin's Kestrel answers 414 to a request line over 8 KB (232 ids on 10.10.7), so a longer list sends its first 175 and says so.
The window begins at the title that starts, so it and what follows play.
Near the end the window reaches back, still holding 175 and the started title.
No follow-up queue commands: a target may drop them while it is still opening; the old 1,000 refusal is gone.
What the controller shows when a list was cut.
